en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a group of people standing on rocky ground in the foreground with a large spa or bath complex of long, low neoclassical buildings in the background, set in a barren, hilly landscape. The layout resembles an early 20th‑century thermal bath resort. Printed captions identify the scene as the baths of Kythnos in Greece, with both Greek and French text on the card.
